_about: Frank Gee Patchin's series for boys and girls (the Pony Rider Boys, the Circus Boys, the Range and Grange Hustlers): every English text under the name at Gutenberg that no other shelf holds. Added 2026-10-17 at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Dates are as each title page gives them; many texts are undated.
